title: Fleet overview
description: Start page. Symptoms first: hosts, services and their clients, the cluster, changes, then logs and telemetry. Every table row and panel title links to the dashboard that explains it.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false",name!~".+-mr-[0-9]+"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: One row per machine, current values. CPU, memory and disk turn orange at 75 % and red at 90 %. Load per core above 1 means work is queueing for the CPU. Select a host to open its detail page.

targets.expr: sum by (host_name) (label_copy(last_over_time(system_cpu_load_average_5m[5m]), "k8s_node_name", "host_name")) / max by (host_name) (label_copy(last_over_time(system_cpu_logical_count[5m]), "k8s_node_name", "host_name") or label_copy(count by (k8s_node_name, host_name) (count by (k8s_node_name, host_name, cpu) (last_over_time(system_cpu_time_seconds_total{state="idle"}[5m]))), "k8s_node_name", "host_name"))

panels.title: CPU busy by host
panels.description: Share of all cores doing work, including iowait and steal. A flat line near 100 % means the host is saturated.

panels.title: Memory used by host
panels.description: Memory held by processes, without page cache. Cache gives memory back on demand, so only this share counts as pressure.

panels.title: Root disk used by host
panels.description: Used share of the root filesystem, as df reports it. Root reserve excluded.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests per second across every Gateway.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of requests answered with 5xx. Above 1 % turns orange, above 5 % red.

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of request duration across all services. Hubble buckets stop at 10 s.

panels.title: Nix cache
panels.description: Garage cluster behind the nix cache. degraded: a storage node is down and quorum holds. unavailable: quorum lost and nix pulls fail.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second split by status class. A rising 5xx band means a backend is failing.

panels.title: Services
panels.description: Each service behind the edge over the selected range: request rate, error share and 95th percentile latency. Select a row for its traffic.

panels.title: Busiest clients
panels.description: Clients with the most requests through the Gateways over the selected range. A pod appears as <namespace>/<workload>. Select a client for its requests.

targets.expr: _stream:{service.name="hubble"} edge.event:=response | stats by (client.name, client.network, geo.country_name) count() requests, count() if (http.response.status_code:>=400) errors, count_uniq(backend.service) services | sort by (requests desc) | limit 10

panels.description: Kubernetes nodes reporting Ready.
Pods in any phase other than Running or Succeeded.

targets.expr: count(max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name) (k8s_pod_phase) != 2 and max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name) (k8s_pod_phase) != 3) or vector(0)

panels.description: Container restarts over the selected range.
Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets with fewer ready pods than desired.

targets.expr: (count(k8s_deployment_available < k8s_deployment_desired) or vector(0)) + (count(k8s_statefulset_ready_pods < k8s_statefulset_desired_pods) or vector(0)) + (count(k8s_daemonset_ready_nodes < k8s_daemonset_desired_scheduled_nodes) or vector(0))

panels.description: Argo CD applications whose live state differs from git.
Argo CD applications reporting a health other than Healthy.
Argo CD syncs over the selected range. Every merged commit syncs the applications it touches.
Syncs over the selected range that ended Failed or Error.
NixOS hosts that switched to another nixos-config revision over the selected range.
Packets that Cilium policy dropped over the selected range.
Share of cluster DNS answers with SERVFAIL or REFUSED.
Flows Hubble could not keep or export. Lost flows leave holes in the request and drop logs.

panels.title: Errors by source
panels.description: Error lines per interval, by Kubernetes namespace or host journal unit. A new band means a new failure.

targets.expr: severity_number:>=17 | stats by (k8s.namespace.name, unit) count() errors

panels.title: Recent errors
panels.description: Newest error lines from every host and pod.

panels.title: Internet in
panels.description: New connections from internet addresses to any host over the selected range.

panels.title: Refused
panels.description: Connection attempts the host firewalls refused over the selected range. Mostly scanners.
Points the collectors failed to deliver, per second. Anything above zero leaves gaps in the panels.
Scraped endpoints that did not answer their last scrape.
Lowest free disk across the metric, log and trace stores.
